lines: So Your three — by own power's spread obtained, six-wheeled, stationed —
they ordain by order, by opening, the varied world-state; by them, devoted-hearted, fear gone may I be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: taditthaṃ te tisro nijavibhavavisphāraṇavaśād | kramād unmeṣeṇa pravidadhati citrāṃ bhavadaśām

verses.craft: Three feminine kept (tisraḥ powers per UNC); ordain-by-opening; fear-gone close.
